editorial.tldr: Coverage of Kimi K3 keeps flagging evidence gaps rather than settled facts: a Jul 22 recap ties the model into the broader open-vs-closed model debate and distillation question, and a Jul 25 report specifically calls out a 15-day gap in the evidence behind the distillation claims.
editorial.whats_new: An Aug 4 report from 36Kr identifies a separate gap — in native multimodal capability — between Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.
editorial.why_it_matters: Two unconfirmed gap claims (distillation evidence, multimodal timing) are circulating about Kimi K3 — verify both independently before citing either as settled in a vendor comparison.
editorial.take_for_builders: Don't take either gap claim — distillation evidence, multimodal timing — at face value in a vendor comparison; both are single-source reports without independent confirmation so far.
